adaptations.purpose: BM25 lexical retrieval with prefix (half idf) and synonym (weight 0.7) expansion.
modifications: documents are Fehm {id, weighted fields} instead of CompressedObservation
Fehm identifier-aware tokenize replaces upstream tokenizer; CJK segmentation removed
exact+prefix scores reported as `lexical`, synonym scores separately as `semantic`
results tie-broken by id (upstream sorted by score only)
no prefix expansion for query terms shorter than 3 characters
sessionId, serialize/deserialize, restoreFrom, observationCountsBySession, clear removed
three `!` non-null assertions for noUncheckedIndexedAccess; algorithm unchanged

adaptations.purpose: Deterministic concept expansion — Fehm's LLM-free semantic signal.
modifications: added FEHM_SYNONYM_GROUPS (login/auth, payment/billing, user/account, connection/pool, handler/controller/route, util/helper, session/token/jwt)

adaptations.purpose: Feature 2 skill memory: bounded confidence per (similar task → skill) from user feedback.
modifications: a lesson is a (similar task → skill) association built from feedback entries, not a stored record
negative feedback weakens symmetrically: c − 0.1·c (upstream weakens only through time decay)
starting confidence 0.5 = no opinion; signal = (c − 0.5)·2 × similarity × recency
relevance is task similarity (term + intent Jaccard ≥ 0.3), not BM25
no persisted confidence, decay sweep, soft delete, KV store or iii SDK

notUsed: AgentMemory server, iii engine, REST/MCP servers, hooks, viewer, vector index, hybrid-search, reranker, persistence, any external database.
note: Local snapshot had no git metadata; the commit was identified by matching all three file hashes against upstream main (2026-09-26). The files differ from tag v0.9.29.
